text: Standing in this space, I feel a sense of curiosity and anticipation. The glass walls and vibrant colors of the R+D exhibit invite me to cross thresholds—literal and intellectual. The environment is modern, with screens and texts hinting at the theme of innovation. The world here feels full of potential, as if on the verge of discovery. Yet I also feel slightly off-balance, confronted by my own reflection in the glass, a reminder that observation itself is an act caught between subject and object, presence and distance.
